title: pm-dispatch: seats settle ruling conflicts, whole-tree lane moves and a standing model/effort word themselves
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86fSdTREudyRc2UtxkkM9SP)_
Fixes #26387
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能的三条规则改由席位自己判:① 卡的某一项与已接受的 ADR 或已记录的裁决冲突时,席位砍掉冲突项、余项照派,卡上行首 `Ruling-ref:` 引出处并逐字引原话,不再挂 `pm:retriage` 等分诊;② 卡的余项按实测文件清单整个落在某车道的包树里时,该车道席自己改 `domain:*`,审计评论同笔列路径与新旧标签,不再绕分诊一圈。限制:只对未派发卡;带 `needs-user-decision`、open `Blocked-by:` 或 `security` 的卡仍走分诊;降级、关卡、其它砍范围仍归人工地板。③ 卡线程的档位与 effort 由席位自己推导(`dispatch-gates --tier` 过卡的路径定档,effort 按卡难度),写进派发令,协调者照派发令开线程,不再等你一句话;你说过的常设原话有则引作 `reason:`。
- **为什么改**:你 2026-10-27 的原话:「这种问题为什么要问分诊,你可以自己判断」「你两个座位可以处理10张卡啊,问题不在座位」「同时立一张skills卡优化技能」;第 ③ 条是你 04:10Z 在决策卡上的选择「B:只写第 4 项」,加你 04:11Z 的原话「#26076: 回一句「同意」用 Fable 档加 xhigh,就能开工。这种为什么需要我确认,你应该自己决定」;#26076 为这一句话从 01:3xZ 等到 04:11Z。卡上量到 spec 车道 13 张队列卡只能派 3 张,其中两张(#26000 与 ADR-0141 D8 冲突、#25653 余项全在 `packages/spec`)是席位能判却去问了分诊。
- **风险与回滚**:只改 `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` 七个文件的 17 行(+17/−17),无脚本、无门禁、无发布面;每个文件行数不变(棘轮 headroom 0 ⇒ 0)。风险在措辞被读宽:席改标只在「余项整树归本席」时成立,`security` 卡与已派发卡明确排除。回滚 = revert 本 PR。卡的第 3 项(同轴串行改按文件面)按你的 B 选项没有写入。
- **先看**:① `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 派发前置节的两行(砍范围的边界)与卡线程节的两行(席位自推导档位与 effort);② `references/execution-duties.md` 候选节新增的两行「席改标」定义与限制;③ `SKILL.md` 红线第 34 行、`pm:retriage` 状态行与认领模板的 `reason:`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` —— 全绿,七个被改文件各自 headroom 0;`git grep -n "pm:retriage" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch` 列出的每处可对照本 PR 的三条新规则逐行读。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(Tier S:`.claude/**`,契约复核 PASS + 席位 ACCEPT 后由席位 ready/arm)。

## What changes

Items **1**, **2** and **4** of the card. Triage's first grade (comment 6431784222) put 1 and 2 on the maintainer's word; item 4 joined on his decision-card tap at 2026-10-27T04:10Z, verbatim **「B:只写第 4 项」** (seat amendment 6433559693). Item 4 then took the wider shape of his later words (04:11Z, relayed verbatim in 6433564592; amendment 2, 6433756084). Item 3 (area-axis serial → file-surface serial) stays ⛔ out under that same tap.

**Ruling-ref** (the card quotes the maintainer verbatim, `domain:spec` seat 1 project thread, 2026-10-27): 「任务很多,还能加速吗」 (01:39Z) · 「你两个座位可以处理10张卡啊,问题不在座位」 (01:41Z) · 「这种问题为什么要问分诊,你可以自己判断。#26000:带 `pm:retriage`。它和已裁的 ADR-0141 D8 冲突,在等分诊答复。」 (01:42Z) · 「同时立一张skills卡优化技能」 (01:42Z).

Every file stays at its line ceiling: a rule added replaces or retires a line in the same file (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14), never a re-wrap. Each line is ≤120 bytes; the one table row stays under the file's 341-byte row pin (269 → 329 bytes).

### Item 1 — seat-settled scope against governing text (`references/dispatch-runbook.md`, 派发前置)

Before (one line):

```text
- 砍范围、降级、关卡是卡的命运,归人工地板 ⛔ 不借改卡裁;读数落认领 `Premise:` 行。
```

After (two lines — the first is the new exit, the second keeps the floor for everything else):

```text
- 卡项与既裁冲突 ⇒ 席砍该项再派 ⛔ 不问分诊;行首 `Ruling-ref:` 引既裁出处,原话逐字。
- 其余砍范围、降级、关卡归人工地板 ⛔ 不借改卡裁;读数落认领 `Premise:` 行。
```

Cutting an item the card itself contradicts is the seat reading a ruling the maintainer already made (triage-duties 不呈 list: 既裁执行), so it is not a new adjudication channel: the seat drops only the conflicting item, dispatches the rest, and the card carries the `Ruling-ref:` line (the key triage already uses, 6431784222; `check-prior-rulings.mjs` treats a `Ruling-ref:` comment as a pointer, never as a ruling) with the governing text quoted verbatim. 降级 and 关卡 — and any other 砍范围 — stay with the human floor. Example (body only, not in the skill): #26000 vs ADR-0141 D8.

Retired to pay the line, same file (`卡线程` section):

```text
- 终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 席位附四维分析与推荐,并入决裁批次呈维护者裁;⛔ 无裁决线程。
```

Surviving homes: `SKILL.md` 升级与决策 「dev 的 `needs_decision` 一律呈人工:PM 附四维分析与推荐…⛔ 不代答」 and `references/coordinator.md` 五 「席位写四维分析加推荐,卡并入决裁批次由维护者人工裁;⛔ 无裁决线程、无代裁」 — the retired line restated both, word for word in effect.

### Item 2 — lane move for an unambiguous remainder

`SKILL.md` L34 (红线), before / after:

```text
- ⛔ 分诊席永不认领卡、派发 dev 飞或写代码;执行席只在本车道认领,永不改 `domain:*`。
- ⛔ 分诊席永不认领、派发或写码;执行席只在本车道认领,改 `domain:*` 仅限整树归本席。
```

`SKILL.md` L112 (`pm:retriage` row), before / after — the two asks the seat now settles are named as ⛔ not triage's; the list keeps 改判, 跨域 PR 指定车道 (the 跨域例外路径 at L173 still has triage designate the lane for a PR that cannot be split), 改路由 for the remainder that is not whole-tree, 拆卡 and 裁 dev 报告的分叉:

```text
| `pm:retriage` | 向分诊提问(改判、跨域 PR 指定车道、改路由、拆卡、裁 dev 报告留下的分叉),定车道与改路由限未派发卡,异议评论写明所求;与现行 `pm:*` 并存、⛔ 不摘原标;带本标签的 `pm:queue` 卡跳过派发 |
| `pm:retriage` | 向分诊提问(改判、跨域 PR 指定车道、改路由、拆卡、裁 dev 报告留下的分叉;既裁冲突砍项与整树席改标归执行席 ⛔ 不问),定车道与改路由限未派发卡,异议评论写明所求;与现行 `pm:*` 并存、⛔ 不摘原标;带本标签的 `pm:queue` 卡跳过派发 |
```

`references/execution-duties.md` 候选与批次 — two new lines after 「候选 = …」 define the exception and its limits (the term 席改标 is the one the other files point at):

```text
- 席改标:卡余项实测路径整落本席包树 ⇒ 本席改 `domain:*`,审计评论列路径与新旧标同笔。
- 席改标限未派发卡;带 `needs-user-decision`、open `Blocked-by:` 或 `security` 的 ⛔ 不改,仍问分诊。
```

Same file, 认领 L60 (the release-time remainder), before / after:

```text
- 同笔 `Release:` 行点名已落项与余项去向;余项需换道/拆分加 `pm:retriage`,自队列重新认领。
- 同笔 `Release:` 行点名已落项与余项;余项整树归他席 ⇒ 点名该席改标,拆分加 `pm:retriage`。
```

Retired to pay the two lines, same file: 派发 L91 「模型分档是 PM 的逐卡显式决定;档位值单源在 dispatch-gates 常量,⛔ 本文不写模型名。」 (surviving homes in the same file: L72 「档位引 `dispatch-gates --tier --repo 仓`⛔ 不凭记忆;天花板拼常量名并同行引据,⛔ 不抄模型 id」 and 「档位逐次派发显式传参,永不省略」) and L140 「对外发布的技能包是平台最大的对外价值,评估恒整包整体。」 (a rationale line; its rule survives at 复核 「触 `skills/**` 的 PR 加问整包价值密度:从整包加载的客户 agent 座位读」 and in `os-dev.md` 「触 `skills/**` …两个读数缺一不可…整包 before/after」).

`references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L32 and L40, before / after:

```text
- 执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领;误标 ⛔ 不自行改,挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔。
- 执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领;误标挂 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔,整树归本席者席改标。
```

```text
- 复核记录带 `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:`;`pm:retriage` 改路由只对未派发卡。
- 复核记录带 `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:`;改路由(`pm:retriage` 或席改标)只对未派发卡。
```

(L40 keeps 改路由只对未派发卡 for both channels.) Example (body only): #25653 — remainder all `packages/spec`, card `domain:server`.

### The triage side (`references/triage-duties.md`), so the triage seat knows it no longer answers these two

L78 before / after:

```text
- `pm:retriage` 每 fire 先答异议评论所求,答后同笔摘标;须维护者答的进收件箱,标照摘。
- `pm:retriage` 每 fire 先答所求、同笔摘标;须维护者答的入箱;既裁砍项与席改标退回执行席。
```

L76 said the same rule from the lane side (「⛔ 不定级不改标」) and now carries the one exception, before / after:

```text
- 车道席可附证据/前提重验,⛔ 不定级不改标;每张卡欠一次分诊首触,车道 ⛔ 不自分诊。
- 车道席可附证据/前提重验,⛔ 不定级,改标限席改标;每张卡欠一次分诊首触,⛔ 不自分诊。
```

### Item 4 — the seat derives a card thread's tier and effort; the maintainer's word is no precondition

**Ruling-ref:** 「#26076: 回一句「同意」用 Fable 档加 xhigh,就能开工。这种为什么需要我确认,你应该自己决定」 and 「是skills有问题吗」, the maintainer, 2026-10-27T04:11Z (relayed verbatim in comment 6433564592; dispatch order amendment 2, 6433756084), after his tap 「B:只写第 4 项」 at 04:10Z. Held cost: #26076 (`docs/adr/**`, MANDATORY ceiling) waited from 01:3xZ to 04:11Z for that one word.

The lines that conditioned a card thread's model and effort on a per-card maintainer message (every hit of `原话` / `逐卡` / `model:` / `effort` in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` that does so — the full hit list is in the report):

`references/dispatch-runbook.md` 卡线程 L138, before (one line) / after (two lines — the standing word, and how it is cited):

```text
- 请 coordinator 开线程附维护者原话消息:它只凭维护者明言设线程的 model 与 effort。
```

```text
- 档位与 effort 席位自推导 ⛔ 不等维护者原话:`--tier` 过路径,MANDATORY 即绑;effort 按难度。
- 派发令写两者与推导(`--tier` 行或难度读数),协调者照令开线程;常设原话有则作 `reason:`。
```

Retired to pay the line, same file (卡线程 section): 「容器重启杀本地后台循环:席位等服务端信号(PR 订阅事件、座位 Routine),本地 watcher 可选。」 — its rule survives in `SKILL.md` 入口与角色 「项目席唤醒 = PR 订阅 + 每项目一个自建自绑的巡查 routine,默认每小时;⛔ 无 `send_later` 链」.

`references/coordinator.md` 四 L33, before / after:

```text
- 席位请线程附维护者原话,coordinator 开线程那一笔同设 model 与 effort(`dispatch-runbook.md`)。
- 按派发令所写的 model 与 effort 开线程,⛔ 不等维护者原话;常设原话有则席位引作 `reason:`。
```

`references/execution-duties.md` 派发 L118 (the effort ladder), before / after — the ladder itself is unchanged; the standing word is now a second source for `max`:

```text
- S 机械 `medium`;M `high`(默认);L/XL/`security`/p1/契约复核/四轴分析 `xhigh`;`max` 凭维护者点名。
- S 机械 `medium`;M `high`(默认);L/XL/`security`/p1/契约复核/四轴分析 `xhigh`;`max` 凭点名或常设令。
```

`SKILL.md` claim template, the `Container & model` line's `model:` placeholder (fenced; the file stays 319 lines): `reason:` now reads 「reason:(逐卡裁决,或常设档位令的 id 与时刻)」 so a standing word, where one exists, is cited there; the derivation that `dispatch-gates.mjs` requires for a ceiling tier is the MANDATORY hit `--tier` printed (or a `reason:`), and a ceiling nobody derived is still a half-state, and `post-stamped` still refuses it. The exits the tier text already has (一行级机械文本降档, 额度耗尽豁免, 主动预降) are untouched.

Hits read and left alone: `coordinator.md` L31 (where the tier and effort are derived — unchanged), L19 (the lane analogue: 维护者 ⛔ 不逐卡点名车道), `execution-duties.md` L72 (`--tier` citation) and L117 (effort written into the claim and the order), `dispatch-runbook.md` L135 (the seat hands the order with a suggested effort), `filing-gate.md` L16–17 and `instrument-discipline.md` L9 (原话 for filing cards and new gates — a different rule), `reading-discipline.md` L28 (原话 for a maintainer's stop).

### One hit the order's hypothesis 1 foresaw as a class (`references/lanes/ui.md` L8)

The grep over `pm:retriage` and `domain:*` found one more line that states the same rule (誤标 ⛔ 不自改) and would have contradicted L32 for the ui seat; it is in the claimed surface (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`) and is reworded in place, before / after:

```text
- ⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,中央分诊唯一生产;误标 ⛔ 不自改,挂 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔。
- ⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,分诊唯一生产;误标 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔,整树归本席除外。
```

Hits read and left alone because they state a different rule: `execution-duties.md` L8 (候选 excludes `pm:retriage` cards), `SKILL.md` L29 and L104 (never dispatch a `pm:retriage` card), `SKILL.md` L170 (who first PRODUCES `domain:*` — a seat move changes an existing label, it produces none), `triage-duties.md` L63 (duplicate cards stay triage's), `state-machine.md` 34–41 (挂标者/摘标者 roles, unchanged), `platform-readings.md` L130 (banned-account recovery), `lanes/director.md` L55, `lanes/hotcrm.md` L8 and L51 (single-lane repos never produce `domain:*`).

### Done-when reading: the spec lane's 「dispatchable / open `pm:queue`」

Read over REST at 2026-10-27T04:02Z, `is:issue state:open label:pm:queue label:domain:spec`: **9** open (the card measured 13 at 01:41Z; #26000 is closed and #25653 dispatched since, both answered by triage at R694 before this PR).

- Under the text on `main`: **0 / 9** dispatchable. Seven are held by the area axis against an in-flight card of the same `area:*` unless the seat measures disjoint file surfaces (#26424 ↔ #25653 identity; #26324 and #26076 ↔ #26370/#26220/#25767 devpath, #26324 also hot-file behind #26220; #26170, #26142, #26128, #26112 ↔ #25785 i18n); two carry no triage first grade yet (#26437, #25579).
- Under this PR's text: **0 / 9** — no card in today's queue is held by either rule this PR changes. What it buys is the next #26000 or #25653: a ruling conflict is settled by the seat in the same round, a whole-tree remainder is relabelled in one write. The seven area-axis holds are the card's item 3 and the two ungraded cards are triage's first grade; neither is this PR's.

## Why

See 维护者速读 and the Ruling-ref above: the maintainer's words settle who judges these two asks; the card measured one round where ten of thirteen cards were held by rule text, not capacity.

## Tests

No code, tests or scripts change. The local gate union below is the test surface for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`; the reading is on the final commit `7d2aaefe` (three commits; the union was run on each head).

## Acceptance notes

- `references/triage-duties.md` 人工地板 line 「卡的命运(关 not planned、降级、撤回、砍半)」 is left as is: a cut forced by a ruling the maintainer already made is 既裁执行 (the 不呈 list, same file), not the seat deciding a card's fate; the new runbook line says so in the only place a seat reads before cutting.
- The order pointed at the audit on #26184 comment 6425678185 「Part A, § pm-dispatch」; Part A has no pm-dispatch section (it is the published-skills gap table). The card's own measured round is the only source used.
- The notification path for a release-time remainder that belongs to another seat (`execution-duties.md` L62 「点名该席改标」) rides the existing cross-seat rule (`cross-repo-coordination.md` 「跨座位请求…在目标卡留一条评论,该评论点名席位与步骤」); no new channel.
